vo.intro: The dollar's decades-long reign is cracking under its own debt, and bond markets are flashing red like never before. Capital is fleeing the old system in search of real safety. Bitcoin stands ready as the escape hatch.

bridges.text: Building on Bitcoin means opting out of the fiat endgame before it collapses.
Its fixed supply cuts through the bond market's endless debt trap like nothing else can.
When safety matters most, Bitcoin delivers the only truly scarce haven left.
